hints.title: Sorting Preserves Subsequences
hints.text: The problem depends only on the minimum and maximum elements of any chosen subset, so sorting nums does not change the answer.

hints.title: Two Pointers Inward Scan
hints.text: With sorted array, maintain left and right pointers. If nums[left] + nums[right] <= target, nums[left] can pair with any subset between left + 1 and right.

hints.title: Power of Two Subsets
hints.text: Add 2 raised to the power (right - left) modulo 10^9 + 7 to total, then increment left. Otherwise decrement right.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsequences is exponential and times out for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting in O(N log N) enables O(N) two-pointer subset counting with precomputed powers of 2.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that sorting is permissible because subset min and max values are order-independent.
